_meta: Sample (fictional person) — Emily Carter, female, born 19 July 1994, 10:15, Toronto. Chart figures are computed by the Minh Bao engine; the text was written for this sample. Any resemblance to a real person is coincidental.
moTaNhanVat: Jung Hye-rin was a Female Governor-General in an old Korean kingdom — a woman who ran a whole region, at ease with both ledgers and soldiers, before whom officials bowed as her palanquin passed. She was respected from an early age and carried authority without having to raise her voice. Her strength was a steady hand over people and resources; her weakness was that her work and her marriage were never truly separate, so trouble in one always spilled into the other. Once she even laid down every title and withdrew to a quiet hermitage before returning to start again. So began a life of high office and hard turns.
ketLuan: That life leaves you today with a natural ease in taking charge and a knack for keeping complicated things in order. It also leaves a habit of letting work and relationships tangle together, and a quiet urge to walk away from everything when the pressure gets too heavy.
